title: The Victor Canopy Where Seasons Sleep

features.name: sleeping-victor
features.desc-on-touch: A eucalyptus burl, vast and ancient, its bark bearing the scars of three seasons' combat. Now it dreams in green. The fight has ended here.

features.name: vanquished-roots
features.desc-on-touch: Three rival root-systems, still intertwined, their competition now monument. The victor's roots wrap the defeated deeper into soil.

features.name: trophy-fruit
features.desc-on-touch: Seed pods and fruit hang ripe and impossible in quantity. The canopy has turned victory into abundance. Touch one and taste the season that won.

features.name: memory-tower
features.desc-on-touch: Stacked growth-rings made visible: spring's ambition, summer's assault, autumn's final push. Each ring carries the pressure of the season below it.

features.name: the-crown-itself
features.desc-on-touch: The canopy's apex, where branches close to lock out competing light. It is not beautiful. It is final. It is what victory looks like in leaves.

features.name: the-sleepers-beneath
features.desc-on-touch: The defeated seasons, compressed into soil, still dreaming. Their dreams feed the victor's roots. In the canopy, all seasons sleep together.

inscription: one season learned to hold all others in its fists and never let go

file.name: Victory_Canopy_Growth_Chamber_Notes.mp3
file.note: A recording of the canopy's dream-frequency, the sound of leaves settling into dominance, the quiet after the seasonal wars.
